Royal Animal Rescue (RAR) was established with the primary objective of providing swift medical transportation for animals. Singapore lacks a specialised ambulance service exclusively dedicated to animals. Our mission is to transform this scenario, aiming to offer an improved service that caters to creatures of all sizes. Our ultimate aim is to prevent any unnecessary loss of cherished companions.

At RAR, our paramedic and rescue team is equipped with comprehensive training to administer diverse first aid procedures tailored to animals. The essence of time is paramount when dealing with injured or unwell animals, and we take this responsibility to heart. Our drivers have undergone specialised training in defensive driving, ensuring a safe and timely journey to the nearest veterinary clinics. We've further outfitted our vehicles with vital medical equipment, a pivotal measure to ensure that our patients experience no further decline in health while en route to receive care.
